registered_chat_goal: Act as the main responsible worker for AI-Statistician: take the hard central AgentRuntime and evaluation work, proactively coordinate other Codex/GitHub branches, preserve strict evidence boundaries, and keep driving the repo toward a live autonomous AI Statistical Theory Lab rather than side audits or easy patches.

canonical_architecture.workspace_loop: the same source-owning model chooses tools or submits complete source; runtime executes the exact source and returns raw observations to that same model
canonical_architecture.artifact_policy: substantive artifacts are stored once by content hash; control state carries references
canonical_architecture.authority_policy: review, retrieval, simulation, and compiler feedback are not proof; exact target-bound Lean or AXLE kernel evidence is required
canonical_architecture.repair_boundary: there is no canonical RepairAgent or content-patching harness; only bounded same-owner source iteration and transient transport/schema retry
forbidden_patterns: runtime-authored statistical or Lean source repair
routine Architect routing inside a source workspace
nested full task or artifact payload copies
